policies.name: Corporate Password Reset
policies.problemDescription: User cannot log in due to forgotten or expired domain credentials.
policies.conditions: User cannot log in due to forgotten or expired domain credentials.
policies.exceptions: VIP executives require immediate phone verification.
policies.resolution: Direct user to self-service portal (SSPR) or reset via Active Directory console.
policies.approvedSolution: Direct user to self-service portal (SSPR) or reset via Active Directory console.

policies.name: Account Lockout Remediation
policies.problemDescription: Account locked after 5 consecutive bad login attempts.
policies.conditions: Account locked after 5 consecutive bad login attempts.
policies.exceptions: Accounts flagged for suspicious geolocation cannot be unlocked without security officer sign-off.
policies.resolution: Verify user identity and clear lockout flag in Active Directory domain controller.
policies.approvedSolution: Verify user identity and clear lockout flag in Active Directory domain controller.

policies.name: Remote Access VPN Connection Troubleshooting
policies.problemDescription: User is unable to establish connection to corporate GlobalProtect or AnyConnect VPN.
policies.conditions: User is unable to establish connection to corporate GlobalProtect or AnyConnect VPN.
policies.exceptions: Contractors require active sponsor approval token before reconnecting.
policies.resolution: Reinstall root security certificates, verify MFA push notification, and restart VPN tunnel service.
policies.approvedSolution: Reinstall root security certificates, verify MFA push notification, and restart VPN tunnel service.

policies.name: Office Network Printer Maintenance
policies.problemDescription: Print spooler errors, paper jams, or missing networked office printers.
policies.conditions: Print spooler errors, paper jams, or missing networked office printers.
policies.exceptions: Personal USB printers not purchased through IT are not serviced.
policies.resolution: Power-cycle the printer, clear jammed paper tray, and restart print spooler service.
policies.approvedSolution: Power-cycle the printer, clear jammed paper tray, and restart print spooler service.

policies.name: Blue Screen and Operating System Crash
policies.problemDescription: Workstation BSOD, kernel panic, or frequent spontaneous operating system restarts.
policies.conditions: Workstation BSOD, kernel panic, or frequent spontaneous operating system restarts.
policies.exceptions: Physical liquid damage requires hardware warranty replacement.
policies.resolution: Inspect minidump files with WinDbg, roll back recent driver updates, and test RAM integrity.
policies.approvedSolution: Inspect minidump files with WinDbg, roll back recent driver updates, and test RAM integrity.
